versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Semantics of the aggregation of meta-class Bina- ryManifestItemPointerValue in the role defaultValue Meta-class Binary- ManifestItemPointerValue is used to provide a default value for a pointer. This means that the default value consists of the address and the symbol of the target object of the pointer. In other words, the memory at the BinaryManifestItem . address is filled with the default target address taken from BinaryManifestItemPointerValue . address .
